name: Drone
needLayer: At least one layer is needed
noAudio: Sound is not available in this browser
set.title: Pads
chord.ftr: A tap plays this chord. Left — major, right — minor, up — sus4+2, down — harm. minor.
about: Sustained note and pads for intonation
help.what: A sustained note or chord to anchor intonation.
help.1: Tap a note to start the drone; tap again to stop.
help.2: Swipe a tile left — major, right — minor, up — sus4+2, down — harmonic minor.
help.tip: Scales over a drone expose tuning slips at once.
worship.ftr: Large hall is a separate long reverb; the sound dissolves into the space. Air is a quiet “breath” on the chord notes.
help.3: Keys — one octave on all layers: “Play” sounds while held, “Hold” toggles on tap.
help.4: Circle: tap a chord; turn it with a finger — the key on top and its chords light up.
chord.ftrOff: Swipes are off: a tap plays only the chord above.
wave.ftr: Soft kill switch: the volume dips and returns, the hall tail rings on.
tour.pad: A pad is a chord of the key. Tap — it sounds, tap again — stop; swipe across a pad — another chord type.
tour.bar: Layers, hold, wave and stop are here.
tour.set: Settings: chords on gestures, sensitivity, wave sound.
arp.title: Arpeggiator
arp.onHint: The pad's chord in gentle motion: instead of the tanpura
arp.needPad: The arpeggiator plays while a pad sounds — tap a pad
arp.motionHint: Life — how often the pattern changes, passing notes and octave shifts, slight unevenness; density — how many notes sound, the rest are rests. “Mix” uses only smooth, reliable moves.
arp.tempoHint: The metronome is silent — the arpeggiator runs at its own tempo.
arp.tempoMetro: The metronome is running — the arpeggiator plays in its tempo and beats.
arp.glideHint: An airy, sustained melody on the degrees of the same key, with echo
arp.lvlHint: By default — in the background under the pad; to the right — louder, up to +12 dB.
